searches.reason: Test whether the training objective is a larger bottleneck than residual gating. Electronics has weaker sampled training separation, while the ungated reference outperformed previous gate proposals. Seek practical multi-negative objectives with false-negative safeguards; compare uniform sampling before introducing moderate-hard mining, keeping one NextItNet model per category.

searches.reason: Explore elapsed time as an alternative to position-only recency gates. Public timestamps can distinguish rapid repeated activity from widely separated interactions. Seek time-conditioned causal dilated convolutions that preserve NextItNet and allow controlled comparisons against position-only decay; the sparse intervention results do not establish that older history should always be suppressed.

searches.reason: Investigate whether jointly learned item representations can distinguish specific products or entertainment content beyond broad ID associations. Seek lightweight title/description encoders trained from scratch within one NextItNet network, with missing-text handling and ID-only controls. Text may improve specificity but cannot establish compatibility or unmet need.
